company.name: OneSchema
company.shortDescription: AI agents for data operations. Automate data prep, standardize client files to RFIs, protect project margins.
company.description: OneSchema provides AI agents for data operations that automate data prep, driving efficiency and improving client project margins. By standardizing raw client files to your RFIs, OneSchema helps teams reach insights and deliver results faster.

productsAndServices.description: A customizable, embeddable tool that enables users to import and validate CSV files directly within a product interface, handling large files and complex data transformations without manual coding.
productsAndServices.name: Embeddable CSV Importer

productsAndServices.description: An AI-powered workflow builder that automates recurring CSV and PDF file imports by recording and replaying data mappings and transformations without requiring engineering or API integration.
productsAndServices.name: FileFeeds

productsAndServices.description: A feature that allows engineering teams to create custom functions to reformat, transform, and validate data during the import process at various stages, enhancing flexibility for unique business logic.
productsAndServices.name: Code Hooks

productsAndServices.description: An automated system that resolves common formatting errors in CSV and PDF files to standardize data for easier processing and integration.
productsAndServices.name: Data Normalization Engine

productsAndServices.description: A system that records detailed logs of all import activities and provides APIs for accessing import data and building automations or analytics.
productsAndServices.name: Audit Logging and API

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,818,321 to $34,346,307, a 9x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
